headline: Tabled $1.5M Newhall Foundation contract and Bethany mutual aid agreement; moved Fire Station 2 and Dixwell Avenue grant applications forward.
summary: Items 4a through 4o passed together by a unanimous vote. The Hamden Fire Department Medicaid enrollment item would make Mayor Adam Sendroff the authorized official for the municipal Medicaid provider. A police agreement on school security cameras and student information was referred for a later vote, tentatively set for December 14, 2026.
decisions: Passed items 4a through 4o together by a unanimous vote, 8-0.
Referred the communication and submission calendar item to Leadership Agenda on 11/24/26 for discussion.
Tabled Hamden Fire Department CT Medicaid enrollment, 6-0.
Tabled the Hamden Fire Department mutual aid agreement with the Town of Bethany, 6-0.
Tabled the bid waiver for a $1.5M contract with Haley & Aldrich for the Newhall Foundation Repair Project, 6-0.
Voted 8-0 to move the Hamden Police Department MOU with UPSEU/Cops for hybrid in-service training.
Voted 8-0 to move forward a $250,000 planning grant application for the Dixwell Avenue corridor.
Voted 8-0 to move forward a $3.5M capital grant reapplication for Fire Station 2.
Voted 5-0 to move forward an order approving State Office of Early Childhood grant funds and authorizing the mayor to sign a contract.
Voted 5-0 to move forward an order accepting legislatively directed funds for a warming center.
Referred the Police Department MOA with Hamden Public Schools on security cameras and student information for a later vote.
Tabled the Public Works intradepartmental budget transfer from Totes to Maintenance, with all members voting in favor.
